# Copilot Instructions — paypayue-dev.github.io

## Project Overview
Developer portal for **PayPay** (Portuguese payment gateway) built with **Docusaurus v3**.
Publishes technical documentation for the PayPay REST API, payment guides, e-commerce integrations, and a legacy SOAP API reference.

---

## Tech Stack
| Tool | Version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Docusaurus | ^3.9.2 | Static site generator |
| React | ^18.3.1 | UI framework |
| @scalar/docusaurus | ^0.3.5 | OpenAPI spec viewer at `/api` |
| docusaurus-lunr-search | ^3.6.0 | Full-text search |
| prism-react-renderer | ^2.4.1 | Code block syntax highlighting |

---

## Commands
```bash
npm start                    # Start dev server (default locale: pt)
npm run start:en             # Dev server in English
npm run start:es             # Dev server in Spanish
npm run start:pt             # Dev server in Portuguese
npm run build                # Production build
npm run serve                # Serve production build locally
npm run clear                # Clear Docusaurus cache
npm run write-translations:all  # Generate i18n translation keys for all locales
```

---

## Localization (i18n)
- **Default locale**: `pt` (Portuguese)
- **Supported locales**: `pt`, `es`, `en`
- Translation strings live in `i18n/{locale}/code.json` (UI strings) and `i18n/{locale}/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current.json` (sidebar labels)
- Docs use `<Translate id="...">fallback text</Translate>` from `@docusaurus/Translate` for inline i18n
- When adding new translatable text, wrap it in `<Translate id="unique.key">PT default text</Translate>` and add the key to all three `code.json` files

---

## Content Structure
```
docs/
  guides/           # REST API integration guides (sidebar: "Guias")
    intro.mdx
    authentication.mdx
    sandbox.mdx
    sdks.mdx
    checkouts/      # Checkout methods (CC, MB, MBWay, embed, mobile, multi-payment, tokenization)
    customers/
    entities/
    payments/       # Payment methods (Multibanco, MB WAY, tokenization)
    terminals/
    webhooks/
  integrations/     # E-commerce plugin guides (sidebar: "Integrações")
    intro.mdx       # Lists available integrations (iGest, InvoiceXpress, PrestaShop, WooCommerce)
    prestashop/
    woocommerce/
    # Hidden: .opencart/, .oscommerce/, .virtuemart/, .zencart/ (prefixed with . = excluded)
  soap/             # Legacy SOAP API docs (DEPRECATED — redirect users to REST guides)
```

Sidebars are **auto-generated** from folder structure via `sidebars.js` (`autogenerated` type).
New `.mdx` files are picked up automatically — no manual sidebar changes needed.

---

## Frontmatter Conventions
Every `.mdx` doc should include:
```yaml
---
sidebar_position: <number>
title: <string>           # Used in sidebar and page title
hide_table_of_contents: true   # Used on most pages
---
```

## Slide-out API Panel (Root.js)
- Shown only on guide pages: `/docs/guides/*/`, `/es/docs/guides/*/`, `/en/docs/guides/*/`
- Embeds an iframe pointing to `customFields.docsApi` (`/api` by default)
- Toggle button labeled "API" opens/closes the panel
- `src/utils/OpenIframe.js` — controls panel open logic
- `src/utils/ClickShowIframe.js` — triggers click events inside the iframe

---

## API Specification (Scalar)
- Route: `/api`
- Specification fetched from `API_URL_SPECIFICATION` env var (default: `/api-dev-spec`, resolved via dev proxy)
- Configured in `docusaurus.config.js` under the `@scalar/docusaurus` plugin

---

## Dev Proxy (webpack devServer)
A `devProxy` plugin is defined in `docusaurus.config.js` to bypass CORS when loading the OpenAPI spec during local development.

**Important:** the proxy only works with `npm start` (webpack dev server). It has **no effect** with `npm run serve` (static file server) or on GitHub Pages (static hosting).

### Current proxy routes
| Context path | Target | Rewritten to |
|---|---|---|
| `/api-dev-spec` | `https://paypay-dev.acin.pt` | `/luis/paypay/api/docs/api.json` |

### `apiUrlSpecification` logic
```js
const apiUrlSpecification = process.env.API_URL_SPECIFICATION || '/api-dev-spec';
```
- When `API_URL_SPECIFICATION` is set → use it directly (bypasses proxy, used in CI/production deployments)
- When not set → uses `/api-dev-spec` which is resolved by the webpack proxy to `paypay-dev.acin.pt`

### Adding a new proxy target (e.g. for a different environment)
1. Add a new entry to the `proxy` array in the `devProxy` plugin
2. Use a conditional spread if the target depends on an env var — e.g.:
```js
...(process.env.API_BASE_URL ? [{
  context: ['/api-spec'],
  target: process.env.API_BASE_URL,
  changeOrigin: true,
  secure: false,
  pathRewrite: { '^/api-spec': '/api/docs/api.json' },
}] : []),
```
3. Update `apiUrlSpecification` to point to the new context path accordingly

### Why `secure: false`?
Required when proxying to HTTPS servers with self-signed or untrusted certificates. Safe for local dev only.

---

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `SITE` | `http://localhost:3000` | Production site URL |
| `API_URL_SPECIFICATION` | `/api-dev-spec` (proxy) | OpenAPI spec URL — when set, used directly (bypasses proxy) |
| `PAYPAY_URL` | `https://paypay-dev.acin.pt/luis/paypay` | PayPay main site URL |
| `FOOTER_ELOGIOS` | `https://www.paypay.pt/elogios-sugestoes-reclamacoes` | Footer link |
| `FOOTER_POLITICAS_PRIVACIDADE` | `https://www.paypay.pt/politica-de-privacidade` | Footer link |
| `FOOTER_POLITICAS_SEGURANCA` | `https://www.paypay.pt/politica-de-seguranca` | Footer link |

```
static/

  plugins/  # third-party plugins
```

---

## Key Patterns & Conventions
1. **MDX over MD** — all documentation files use `.mdx` extension to allow JSX/React components
2. **i18n-first** — all user-facing strings must use `<Translate>` and have entries in all 3 `code.json` files
3. **Sidebar order** — controlled by `sidebar_position` frontmatter, not by `sidebars.js`
4. **Hidden integrations** — directories prefixed with `.` (e.g., `.opencart/`) are excluded from the sidebar
5. **SOAP docs are deprecated** — always direct users to REST guides instead
6. **Blog is disabled** — `blog: false` in config
